If you wreck Great Landorus's little
shrine, it'll cause a bad bad storm!{VAR BE01}
No, silly, you've got it wrong!{VAR BE01}
No, YOU'RE silly! Hey, wait!{VAR BE01}

That's a story from way long ago, when
my grandpa was a little boy.{VAR BE01}

So if Tornadus and Thundurus come here
again, Great Landorus may come back.{VAR BE01}
That's what my grandpa told me!
It's a small, weathered shrine.{VAR BE01}

Tornadus and Thundurus are struggling
inside their Poké Balls!{VAR BE01}
Landorus flew far away into the sky...
